Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
I know heidelburg castle is a nightmare for the rulemonger. I know it can't
be tapped during an action or during combat, but between actions. But how
about the master phase ? I know people use it to minion tap a big vampire
and move one or two blood from a smaller one after that. But what about
tapping it in a reactive way ?
If I play golconda or Anachronism on one of my prey's vampire, can he tap
heidelburg to move blood, retainers and/or equipments to someone else before
the master card takes effect ?

thank you
reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Hi !
> I know heidelburg castle is a nightmare for the rulemonger. I know it can't
> be tapped during an action or during combat, but between actions. But how
> about the master phase ? I know people use it to minion tap a big vampire
> and move one or two blood from a smaller one after that. But what about
> tapping it in a reactive way ?

OK.

> If I play golconda or Anachronism on one of my prey's vampire, can he tap
> heidelburg to move blood, retainers and/or equipments to someone else before
> the master card takes effect ?

No. There is no interrupt-stack in V:TES. Goldconda reslves when played.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> If I play golconda or Anachronism on one of my prey's vampire, can he tap
>> heidelburg to move blood, retainers and/or equipments to someone else
>before
>> the master card takes effect ?
>
>No. There is no interrupt-stack in V:TES. Goldconda reslves when played.

But note that Heidelburg can be used on non-immediate Masters. A while ago
someone asked about using Heidelburg on a vampire that was targeted by ToGP and
apparently you could take off the blood and stuff before the ToGP bidding
finishes.

Halcyan 2
